customer_content.customer_title: OneNav Evolution Multimedia Receiver for Toyota Corolla Cross A11 (2021+)
customer_content.customer_description: Touchscreen multimedia receiver for Toyota Corolla Cross A11 (2021+). Supports wired and wireless OneConnect, Wireless CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth 5.4, FM/AM RDS radio, high-speed USB charging and USB media input. Audio connections include 5 × 4 V RCA outputs and 4 × 45 W speaker output; digital sound processing with a 12-band equaliser is built in. Front and rear camera inputs are optional. Manufacturer lists a three-year warranty.
